description: The ships that passed within a radius of a port (UN/LOCODE) or a point (lat and lon) over the last 1, 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours, the most recently seen first: who each is, when she was first and last inside, and how close she came. The radius can be up to 25 km near the equator and less towards the poles. Follow any of them with get_track or get_ship.

lat.description: Latitude of the point, with lon.

limit.description: At most this many ships, the most recently seen.

locode.description: A port's UN/LOCODE, five letters; or give lat and lon instead.

lon.description: Longitude of the point, with lat.

radiusKm.description: How far out to look, in kilometres.

name: get_area_history

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

from.description: The window's start: later than asked when the area was too busy for all of it.

closestKm.description: Her nearest position to the centre.

firstSeen.description: Her first position inside the radius.

kind.description: The map's class for her AIS type.

lastSeen.description: Her last position inside the radius.

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

to.description: The window's end, a few minutes ago.

total.description: Every ship that passed; ships lists the most recently seen of them.

trimmed.description: busy: the window was cut to its newest hours; history: positions were not indexed that far back.

truncated.description: True when more ships passed than the limit.
